zh: 新增侧栏「更多」菜单里的「编辑侧栏…」：在对话框中勾选哪些入口显示在侧栏，取消勾选的入口收进「更多」菜单顶部，点开照样能用，选择在重启后保留；「更多」入口的图标改为三个圆点，设置页「侧栏」中可以关闭这项功能。
en: Add Edit sidebar… to the sidebar's More menu: a dialog chooses which entries the sidebar shows, an unchecked entry moves to the top of More and still opens from there, and the choice survives a restart; the More entry now shows three dots, and the Sidebar tab in settings can turn the feature off.
